text:
viv: Heads up — product is green for next Wed launch. Need a compact micro-benchmark kit + routing diagram for inbound leads. Deliverables: hero banner (1200x628), three microtiles (600x400), one-pager PDF template, and a simple webhook mapping CSV. Keep messaging tight and visually focused on latency vs cost. Deadline: first comps by Mon noon. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

omar: Copy. Can you share the source numbers and any visual examples you like? Also prefer dark/light logo variants and accessible color tokens.

viv: Data spreadsheet: https://files.redwood/launch/benchmetrics.csv. Prefer latency on x-axis, cost on y-axis, and a mini-sparkline inset showing per-token cost over time. Reference look: minimal econ charts we used in Q4. Use Primary Cyan for latency (#0AB3E6) and Warm Orange for cost (#FF8A55).

lia: Design notes: use Inter/700 for headings, Inter/400 for body. Maintain 20px padding on microtiles. Run AA contrast checks; provide alt text for each image. For hero variants, create A/B headline lengths: A) 5 words, B) 8 words.

omar: Got it. For routing diagram: do you want separate flows for Hosted / Dedicated / Private? Any tags we should include?

viv: Yes 1 hosted -> marketing-nurture, dedicated -> sales-route, private -> partner-engage. Form tags: source, plan, intent. CSV mapping example to include in ticket:
```
form_field,webhook_key
utm_source,source
plan_selector,plan
interest,intent
```
Also include webhook endpoint example and note to redact api keys in mockups.

lia: Motion allowed? small svg draw for sparkline only. Keep <7s duration. No autoplay for large images.

omar: Legal bot: any trademark or model mentions to flag?

legalbot: If mentioning third-party model names, include attribution line and check partner logos with brand team. Keep claims conservative ("reduces per-token cost by up to X%" needs source). We'll review comps once uploaded.

omar: I'll produce two hero comps + microtile grid. Will set up Figma file with export slices and include a PDF one-pager template. Deliver by Mon noon as PNGs + figma link.

viv: Great. Also create short CTAs: 
- "Try Hosted API"
- "Schedule Dedicated Demo"
- "Download one-pager"

lia: One more: include small accessibility footer (font size >=12px) and ensure logo clearspace 24px.

omar: Copy that. Creating ticket DESIGN-4910 and assigning to omar. Will ping here when comps are ready. :white_check_mark:

viv: Thanks team. If anything blocks — ping me directly. :rocket:
